scope: coding-agent product fork only; lower agent/provider layers unchanged

npm_distribution.relation: The worker installs the npm registry tarball of the same 0.85.1 release built from the pinned commit. Its package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json are byte-identical to upstream/package.json and upstream/npm-shrinkwrap.json (hashes in files), and the lockfile's nested tree under it is exactly that shrinkwrap (packages/pi-worker/test/worker-deps.test.ts). With the empty patch inventory this registry tarball is the narrow fork's runnable distribution. Unpatched; only root exports are imported, plus pi-ai's root entry from the copy nested under it (src/worker/pi-ai.ts), so exactly one pi-ai is installed and loaded.
npm_distribution.install: npm --prefix packages/pi-worker ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund (the skipped install scripts are esbuild's binary check, protobufjs's version-scheme warning and @google/genai's no-op preinstall, none needed by the worker; see docs/implementation/build.md)

@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.use: SDK root exports: createAgentSession, ModelRuntime, SessionManager, SettingsManager, DefaultResourceLoader; its nested pi-ai root entry (createAssistantMessageEventStream, getSupportedThinkingLevels, stream types) for the lade-fixture provider and the catalogue

undici.use: global dispatcher tunnelling through the LADE gateway socket; the version pi pins
